# SAI.YIP

> Smart Adaptive Intelligence for YIP Kerala. Free bilingual (English + Malayalam) learning PWA for Class 6-10: 15 challenges across Reasoning, Observation, Logic, Coding and Problem Solving, with adaptive difficulty and a teacher portal.

- [Home](https://sai-yip.pages.dev/)
- [Lessons](https://sai-yip.pages.dev/) (Lessons tab — Duolingo-style roadmap, challenge last)
- [Progress](https://sai-yip.pages.dev/) (Progress tab — SVG donut + skill bars)
- [Coding Lab](https://sai-yip.pages.dev/) (Coding Lab tab — JS on-device, Python via free runners)
- [Teacher portal](https://sai-yip.pages.dev/) (Teacher tab — scan a student QR for instant reports)
- [Health API](https://sai-yip-api.workers.dev/api/health)

## Rules

- Rs.0 stack: [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/) + Google Sheets + project Drive.
- Login is QR scan (KVAD-001 format) or demo; teachers use TCH-001 school codes.
- Student data belongs to the school sheet; demo mode never touches it.
